Upstream is an ES-module isometric builder (type=module, PNG asset pack,
localStorage). GifOS inlines <script src> as classic scripts and drops
type=module, and a sandboxed app cannot fetch the pictures, so that path
cannot ride in.

world.js keeps the Mediterranean palette, the voxel cube helpers
(box / shell / dome / cylinder / compose), and the procedural builders
for the starter village from src/assets/voxelRenderer.js,
src/assets/assetDefinitions.js, src/config.js, and the seed in src/main.js
at the pin above. The walk, the orbit, and extra people are the GifOS port.
The original had no walker and no networking.
